name: domain-watchdog-worker
description: Background worker for Domain Watchdog. Processes RDAP lookups, domain drop attempts, and async queue tasks. Must be deployed alongside the domain-watchdog container. All connection strings must match exactly.

variables.name: JWT Passphrase
variables.description: Must match the JWT Passphrase set in the domain-watchdog container.

variables.name: App Secret
variables.description: Must match the App Secret set in the domain-watchdog container.

variables.name: Worker Consumer Name
variables.description: Internal messenger identifier. Leave as worker.

variables.name: Database URL
variables.description: Must match the Database URL set in the domain-watchdog container exactly.

variables.name: Redis Async DSN
variables.description: Must match the domain-watchdog container setting.

variables.name: Redis RDAP Low DSN
variables.description: Must match the domain-watchdog container setting.

variables.name: Redis RDAP High DSN
variables.description: Must match the domain-watchdog container setting.

variables.name: Redis Lock DSN
variables.description: Must match the domain-watchdog container setting.
